purpose: Different cross-work Top K recommendations from metadata, with reproducible style agreement on disjoint original-index blocks
scope: Follow-up exploratory analysis on previously inspected evaluation data; catalog-specific normalization references; no listener ground truth or claim of statistical independence

cohort.queries: Existing family-clean test role, known work_type, common finite B/T/R/model inputs
cohort.gallery: Existing train role, known work_type, common finite B/T/R/model inputs
cohort.exclude: Query family_id, including alternate movements and Bach paired BWV
cohort.metadata_unknown: Exclude from common primary cohort, retain count and reason
cohort.judge_cohort: Both A/B directions and all primary judge blocks and search methods supported; freeze before ranking
cohort.missing: No zero imputation, no method-specific candidate pools, no post-outcome relaxation

methods.categorical_distance: Mismatch indicator; M-CT averages composer and known work_type mismatch
methods.B_distance: Existing five feature group equal-weight squared distance; seven representative/range channels, 14D
methods.hand_scaling: Family/work/recording balanced train mean and SD, constants removed on train only; RMS coordinate distance
methods.hybrids: Divide each block distance by weighted median finite supported cross-family train pair distance; equal mean squared block distance; zero-scale block is unsupported
methods.pair_calibration: Cross-family train pairs weighted by product hierarchical family/work/recording weights, excluding within-family pairs and renormalizing
methods.learned: Frozen CNN and BiLSTM 128D mean+SD window pooling, cosine, all three encoder seeds

retrieval.primary: Sort recordings and keep at most one recording per family
retrieval.secondary: Uncapped recording Top K on same corpus
retrieval.insufficient: Keep unsupported status if available families < K; do not reduce K
retrieval.tie_tiers: Sorted distances; membership within tolerance of first distance in tier, no transitive chaining
retrieval.tie_policy: Same query/candidate random priorities across methods, then family cap
retrieval.tie_internal_reference: Metadata list-to-list overlap between seed i and seed (i+1) mod 100

experiment_B.view_A: Even block indices starting at index zero
experiment_B.boundary_policy: No delta/run/lag crosses blocks or missing intervals; no compressed-concatenation index
experiment_B.learned: Reencode only valid search-side 64-beat windows with fixed checkpoints, pool mean+SD
experiment_B.normalization_caveat: Existing full-catalog reference/scale retained; beat disjointness does not imply fully independent preprocessing
experiment_B.distance_scaling: Separate gallery search-side scaling for each direction; judge scales from train judge-side only

E_L.group_weights: Five feature groups equal; Pedaling channels averaged within group

E_T.scope: Local change magnitude distribution; not full sequence order
E_T.secondary_diagnostics: Direction reversals and run lengths with support counts; never substitute primary score

E_R.secondary_pairs: Other original nonderived pairs with explicit support; never replace primary pair

judging.metric: Train-standardized group-balanced RMS; per-query candidate distance percentile
judging.score: P(random hierarchical gallery candidate distance > selected distance) + 0.5 P(tie); average returned K; larger is better
judging.missing: Never replace undefined directions or constant Pearson by zero; same common cohort

controls.uniform: Uniform families without replacement, then uniform works then recordings
controls.same_work: Keep returned piece/grid IDs; resample only recording uniformly, with original recording allowed
controls.within_work_rank: Compare selected candidate to all other recordings of same piece/grid; fraction farther + half ties
controls.conditionally_permuted: Reassign entire search embedding jointly to gallery keys inside composer × work_type × train weighted log-beat quartile × coverage bin; leave query search and judge embeddings unchanged, rerun ranking
controls.conditional_support: At least 80% of gallery recordings belong to non-singleton strata; report same-piece-only exchanges separately

experiment_B.novel_subset: Per metadata tie seed, retained candidates absent from M-CT list; >=3 novel candidates required per query; conditional descriptive result, never substitutes full-list primary scores

robustness.balanced_gallery: Twenty galleries with three recordings per eligible family; uniform works then recordings without replacement, same gallery all methods
robustness.insufficient_family_recordings: Exclude only from this supplementary experiment and publish availability

uncertainty.aggregation: Average directions/tie/control seeds within query, then equal works then families; seed repeats do not increase sample size
uncertainty.below_minimum: Per-work descriptive results, no interval claim
uncertainty.scope: Query-family variability conditional on fixed shared gallery; not population-wide confirmation

interpretation.differentiation: Publish overlap continuously with metadata tie variation; no arbitrary independence cutoff
interpretation.supported_style_gain: Positive mean primary delta and lower paired primary interval > 0, report controls and per-family consistency; otherwise descriptive/unresolved
interpretation.conditional_style_claim: Require same-work recording advantage; disclose M-CTQ and conditional shuffle support/outcome; unresolved controls restrict claim
interpretation.knowledge_gain: Primary intended judge improves; report all judge axes and novel subset without substituting endpoints
interpretation.limits: Numerical defined-style consistency only; not listening preference, ground-truth music similarity, or zero dependence on metadata

example: First eligible test query sorted by piece then key, fixed in preflight, never selected by outcome
